name: Lady with water basin
material: Hanging scroll; multicolor woodblock print on paper
dimensions: Print only: 68.5 x 45.7 cm (26 15/16 x 18 in.); Mounted: 219 x 64 cm (86 1/4 x 25 3/16 in.)
summary: In the 1600s, printing flourished in such Jiangnan cities as Nanjing, Suzhou, Hangzhou, and Huizhou, evolving from privately enjoyed illustrated books printed in color to more commercialized single-sheet color prints that were hung on walls and became part of the rich urban visual culture.
